questions.question: Mina, now a national reference in conservative dentistry, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Conservative dentistry is a model of minimally invasive dentistry
Conservative dentistry is reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Conservative dentistry is a model of minimally invasive dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote conservative dentistry. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting tooth preservation is essential for the future of the profession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'
